params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Resonance:}} '''Ekko's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and damaging {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Resonance'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes them all to deal {{pp|30 to 70 by 10; 80 + (140-80)/12*(x-1) for 15|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. ''Z-Drive Resonance'' deals 270% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.description2: ''Resonance'' cannot affect the same target more than once every few seconds.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Stolen Time:}} Triggering ''Resonance'' against a {{tip|champion}} grants '''Ekko''' {{pp|key=%|50 to 80 for 4|1 to 16|color=movement speed}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{pp|2 to 3 for 3|1 to 11}} seconds.
params.notes:
* '''Ekko's''' basic attacks have different animations based on how many stacks his target has. His attack pattern is as follows: 
** {{tt|Downwards|first stack}} → {{tt|Upwards|second stack}} → {{tt|Sideways|third stack to consume all stacks}}
*** If the target has already been affected by ''Resonance'', '''Ekko's''' basic attack animations will kick or attack the target sideways.
* ''Resonance'' stacks will not be applied nor consumed if the basic attack is {{tip|dodged}} or {{tip|blocked}} or if the attack {{tip|blind|misses}}.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Ekko|Ekko's}} {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and damaging {{tip|abilities}} apply {{tip|stacks}}, the third stack deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. If the target was a {{tip|champion}}, this grants {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} to '''Ekko'''.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' throws a temporal grenade in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description2: At 700 units or upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, the grenade slows down for {{fd|1.75}} seconds to gradually expand into a ''Temporal Sickness'' field that {{tip|slows}} nearby enemies, travelling for another 190 units.
params.description3: Afterwards, the grenade contracts and homes back to '''Ekko''' at an increased speed, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.leveling3: {{st|Return Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 140}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|80+40 to 140+140}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30+70}}% AP)}}}}
params.description4: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ekko}} throws a temporal grenade that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. It expands at max range or upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} nearby enemies.
params.blurb2: After a delay, the grenade homes back to '''Ekko''', dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Ekko's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|3% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''missing''' health|health}} against enemies below {{sti|health|{{as|30% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}. The damage has a minimum threshold of 15 and is capped at 150 against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' creates an afterimage of himself that, after 2 seconds, bats a device to the target location and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. After travelling over {{fd|1.25}} seconds, the device expands into a chronosphere that lasts for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and which {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within by 40%.
params.description3: If '''Ekko''' enters the sphere before it expires, it detonates to grant him a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds and {{tip|stun}} enemies within for {{fd|2.25}} seconds.
params.description4: ''Enemies can see the indicator for Parallel Convergence 2 seconds after casting.''
params.notes:
* The passive will proc with the attack that triggers the final stack of {{ai|Z-Drive Resonance|Ekko|Resonance}} if it reduces a target's health below the 30% threshold.
* '''Ekko''' can detonate the expansion even while {{tip|untargetable}} (i.e. {{ais|Chronobreak|Ekko}} dash), but not if he is {{tip|resurrection|resurrecting}}.
* ''Parallel Convergence'' will continue to {{tip|slow}} enemies even if its expansion is detonated.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Ekko}} basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} against a {{as|low-health}} target, increased based on {{as|their '''missing''' health}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' indicates the target location where a sphere will be created, which {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within.
params.blurb3: If '''Ekko''' enters the sphere, it detonates, {{tip|stun|stunning}} enemies within and granting '''Ekko''' a {{sti|shield}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, then empowers his next basic attack within 3 seconds to have a {{fd|0.25}}-second cast time, gain {{sti|range|300 '''bonus''' range}}, cause him to {{tip|blink}} within {{tt|125|Estimated}} range of the target, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
params.description2: ''Phase Dive {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Ekko's''' basic attack timer. '''Ekko''' can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''
params.target range: {{dv|{{tt|325|Dash distance}}|{{tt|550|Maximum increased dash distance across terrain}}}}
params.notes:
* The {{tip|dash}} distance can be extended to up-to 550 units when targeting across terrain. It will only extend for the distance needed to cross the wall.
* While {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}, '''Ekko''' loses the {{sti|'''bonus''' attack range}} from ''Phase Dive''.
* ''Phase Dive's'' attack can {{tip|blind|miss}} and be {{tip|blocked}} and {{tip|dodged}}, consuming the basic attack without dealing any damage.
* ''Phase Dive's'' attack {{tip|break stealth|breaks stealth}} at the start of its cast time.
** This is relevant for external sources of {{tip|stealth}} such as {{cai|Curse of the Black Mist|Senna}}.
* If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away during the empowered attack's cast time, it is cancelled but not consumed.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ekko}} {{tip|dash|rolls}} in the target direction, gaining {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}}.
params.blurb2: His next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|blink|blinks}} him to the target and deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Upon learning ''Chronobreak'' or if its '''current''' cooldown is lower than 4 seconds, '''Ekko''' reveals a time-delayed ''afterimage'' of himself that constantly tracks where he was 4 seconds ago.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' enters {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} at the start of the cast time, and afterwards {{tip|heals}} himself, increased by {{as|{{pp|label1=health lost|key=%|key1=%|type=health lost in the last 4 seconds|0 to 300 for 11|0 to 100|formula=3% per 1% of health lost in the last 4 seconds}}|health}}, and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to his ''afterimage's'' location at the time of cast over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Upon arrival, the stasis ends and he creates an explosion that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 500}} {{as|(+ 175% AP)}}}}{{st|Minimum Heal|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|400 to 800}} {{as|(+ 240% AP)}}}}
params.description3: '''''Ekko''' is immune to all {{tip|airborne|displacements}} during Chronobreak.''
params.notes:
* '''Ekko''' will attempt to basic attack the closest target after appearing at the cast location, but can do so quicker if he manually attack commands after the dash, except if {{ai|Phase Dive|Ekko}} is primed.
* The ''afterimage's'' location will explode even if '''Ekko's''' {{tip|dash}} is interrupted.
* A ''link'' can also be seen between the ''afterimage'' and '''Ekko''' that traces along his path.
** The ''link'' follows the same visibility rules as the ''afterimage''.
** Upon activation, '''Ekko''' travels full distance through the ''link'', and thus will detonate {{ai|Parallel Convergence|Ekko}} that the ''link'' passes through.
* {{ii|Quicksilver Sash|icononly=true}} {{nie|Quicksilver}} incurs a 1-second {{sti|cooldown}} upon casting ''Chronobreak''.
* '''Ekko's''' dash cannot be interrupted by forced movement displacements since he is immune to them.
** This is not to be confused with {{tip|displacement immunity}}, which resists {{tip|airborne}} displacements plus a number of other cases. ''Chronobreak'' provides immunity only to displacements that apply {{tip|airborne}}.
params.tips:
* The ''afterimage'' instantly spawns upon learning ''Chronobreak''. This may be used once per match for a stealthy ''Chronobreak'' usage.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Ekko}} reveals a time-delayed ''afterimage'' of himself that tracks where he was 4 seconds ago.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' enters {{tip|stasis}} and {{tip|dash|rewinds}} to the ''afterimage'', {{as|{{sti|healing}}}} based on the damage received in the last 4 seconds. He then explodes, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
